thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: p99 streaming latency breach (region: us-west-2). Metric: streaming.latency.p99 > 1500ms for 3m. Affected service: continuous-batching runtime path. Grafana: https://grafana/redwood/d/streaming

oncall-aaron: ack — taking initial triage. tagging eng-runtime and eng-sre.

rishi: seeing correlated rise in contbatch queue length and pack-shed rate. mixed seqlen traffic spike at 22:12 UTC.

maya: customer-impact estimate? any 5xx or errors?

support-elena: CS reports 2 small customers opened tickets complaining about slow chat replies ~2–3s. no large-scale 5xx.

jamie: logs show streaming path falling into contbatch fallback for long requests (kv cache misses). tail requests being batched with short seqs — padding amplification. p95 only slightly up, p99 huge.

oncall-aaron: quick mitigation plan: 1) disable contbatch for streaming routing 2) reduce contbatch max_batch_size to 8 3) enable preemptive shed for packer 4) evict KV hotkeys on affected nodes. I'll run changes in that order.

rishi: +1. How to flip routing quickly? feature flag via infra-api.

oncall-aaron: running now —
```
curl -X POST https://infra-api.internal/flags
 -H 'Authorization: Bearer $OP_TOKEN'
 -d '{"flag":"disable_contbatch_for_streaming","value":true}'
```

incident-bot: Flag change accepted (req id d3f2). Propagating to edge.

maya: reducing max_batch_size on contbatch pool (us-west-2) to 8 — applying config patch.
```
PATCH /api/v1/pools/contbatch-usw2
{ "max_batch_size": 8, "batch_timeout_ms": 12 }
```

jamie: started KV hotkey eviction on 3 hosts: gpu-14, gpu-15, gpu-18. command: `redis-cli -h kv-host --scan --pattern hotkey:* | xargs redis-cli -h kv-host del`

support-elena: notifying the two affected customers that we're investigating (no SLA breach yet, monitoring).

oncall-aaron: monitoring metrics. initial telemetry: p99 dropped from ~2400ms -> ~900ms in 45s after flag flip. pack-shed reduced.

rishi: good signal. still seeing a minority (~0.6%) of streaming tails > 1.5s. likely mixed-seqlen amplification on remaining nodes. recommend temporary routing to streaming-only pool for the highest QPS customers.

maya: can enable routing rule for top-5 routes to stream-only. Doing a gradual rollout (10% -> 50% -> 100%).

jamie: added a short-term fairshare tweak: decrease contbatch weight for 'short' seqlen class to reduce padding stealing. config diff: `fairshare.short_weight: 0.6 -> 0.3`

slo-bot: SLO watch: streaming.latency.p99 back under threshold for 2m, but p99 window still noisy. alert auto-resume in 10m if stable.

oncall-aaron: ops summary so far: cause = contbatch path mixing long streaming requests + short requests -> padding amplification + KV misses -> batch scheduling fairness problem. Mitigations: flag disable, reduce max_batch_size, KV eviction, fairshare tweak, routing rule.

rishi: follow ups: 1) run pad-aware batching experiment in canary 2) add metric: pct of batches with >1 long request 3) investigate KV TTL/eviction policy for streaming prefixes 4) postmortem if customers see SLO slip.

support-elena: CS will track tickets and surface any escalation. recommending proactive email to affected accounts once we have 1 hour of stable metrics.

oncall-aaron: handing off to eng-runtime for next-shift followup. leaving runbook notes in /runbooks/contbatch-tail-latency.md and the incident channel.

jamie: noted. adding a short-term dashboard (streaming-tail-debug) and an alert rule for contbatch.pack_shed_rate > 0.3.

maya: rolling back the flag after 20m if stable? or we keep until config changes are deployed?

rishi: keep disabled until we deploy padding-aware scheduler + KV improvements. rollback may reintroduce tails.

oncall-aaron: agree. set incident state -> mitigation in progress. paging off for now.

incident-bot: Incident recorded: id INC-2026-6311. Severity: Sev2. Linked playbook: /playbooks/contbatch_tail. Pager auto-muted.

support-elena: Customer impact note: ~0.6% streaming p99 over threshold during spike window (22:10–22:20). two tickets opened, CS assigned.

rishi: marking action items in the ticket. will schedule a postmortem tomorrow 11:00 UTC if metrics stable.

oncall-aaron: thanks team. leaving handoff: @jamie to own short-term dashboard, @maya to own config rollout, @rishi to own postmortem. ping me if anything regresses. :thumbsup:
